direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has turned toward Kasun as he offers her phone back. His small food three-wheeler stands behind him.
direction.people: Anudi stands on the left in a cream blouse and muted teal skirt, grateful and a little surprised. Her open umbrella is in her left hand and her handbag rests on her left forearm. Kasun faces her from the right in a faded blue shirt and dark trousers, friendly and helpful, holding the phone out in his right hand.

flow.text: Anudi looks at the phone as Kasun holds it steady between them. She takes it in her right hand, their fingertips hidden by the phone, and lifts her gaze to him.

flow.how: Warm and genuinely grateful, with mild surprise, smiling as her eyebrows lift and she holds the phone at her right waist
flow.listener: Kasun meets her gaze with quiet warmth.

flow.text: Anudi holds her smile. Kasun lets his empty right hand settle.

direction.camera: An eye-level waist-up two-shot from the road side, on a 40mm lens, holds in a steady frame on a tripod.
direction.sound: Light rain, distant traffic and soft phone handling; no music.
